Houston Rockets — injuries
Head coach Ime Udoka said Wednesday that Adams (calf) is still without a timetable to return and will be evaluated on a "weekly basis," Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.
Adams hasn't played since Oct. 23 due to a right soleus strain and remains without a definitive timetable to return. Oscar Tshiebwe figures to see increased burn until Capela (ankle) or Adams returns.
